Remoting.description: Legacy .NET Remoting, BinaryFormatter, and related serialization APIs that are deprecated and removed for security reasons. Remoting provided distributed object communication but had significant security vulnerabilities. Migrate to gRPC, HTTP APIs, or modern serialization (System.Text.Json, protobuf).
Remoting.label: Deprecated Remoting & Serialization

Api.0003.label: Behavioral change in selected .NET version

Wpf.description: WPF APIs for building Windows desktop applications with XAML-based UI that are available in .NET on Windows. WPF provides rich desktop UI capabilities with data binding and styling. Enable Windows Desktop support: Option 1 (Recommended): Target net9.0-windows; Option 2: Add <UseWindowsDesktop>true</UseWindowsDesktop>.
Wpf.label: WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation)

WinFormsLegacyControls.description: Legacy Windows Forms controls that have been removed from .NET Core/5+ including StatusBar, DataGrid, ContextMenu, MainMenu, MenuItem, and ToolBar. These controls were replaced by more modern alternatives. Use ToolStrip, MenuStrip, ContextMenuStrip, and DataGridView instead.
WinFormsLegacyControls.label: Windows Forms Legacy Controls

GdiDrawing.description: System.Drawing APIs for 2D graphics, imaging, and printing that are available via NuGet package System.Drawing.Common. Note: Not recommended for server scenarios due to Windows dependencies; consider cross-platform alternatives like SkiaSharp or ImageSharp for new code.
GdiDrawing.label: GDI+ / System.Drawing

WinForms.description: Windows Forms APIs for building Windows desktop applications with traditional Forms-based UI that are available in .NET on Windows. Enable Windows Desktop support: Option 1 (Recommended): Target net9.0-windows; Option 2: Add <UseWindowsDesktop>true</UseWindowsDesktop>; Option 3 (Legacy): Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop SDK.
WinForms.label: Windows Forms

WindowsRegistry.description: APIs for accessing the Windows Registry that are available via NuGet package Microsoft.Win32.Registry. The Registry APIs have been moved to a separate package for better platform separation. Windows-only feature - install the Microsoft.Win32.Registry package.
WindowsRegistry.label: Windows Registry

Binding.0005.description: Manual binding redirects exist but are missing a redirect for a referenced assembly with a version mismatch. This can cause MissingMethodException or FileLoadException when the missing redirect allows the app to start but fails when a specific code path is hit.
Binding.0005.label: Missing binding redirect for referenced assembly

Binding.0007.description: A binding redirect's newVersion is lower than the version provided by the NuGet package. This forced downgrade usually causes a load failure at runtime because the expected assembly version is not available.
Binding.0007.label: Binding redirect forces version downgrade

Binding.0008.description: An assembly reference version differs from the version provided by the target NuGet package and no binding redirect covers this range. This causes FileLoadException because the CLR cannot resolve the version mismatch.
Binding.0008.label: Assembly version mismatch with insufficient redirect coverage
